verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated pricing-and-limits doc detailing request/token rate limits, response headers like x-ratelimit-remaining-requests, how to monitor usage by API key/model, workspace budgets, and how limits scale by tier (Basic vs Pro/Enterprise via email verification). This directly documents rate limits and tier-based scaling before hitting production limits. Missing for 10: no explicit numeric rate-limit tables per tier and no independent/community corroboration of actual limits encountered in practice.
